annotations.title: Prepare or send a payment reminder

description: Use this when the user asks to remind a client to pay, chase an unpaid or overdue invoice, or send a payment reminder. Sends the client a payment reminder for an issued unpaid invoice, exactly as Fatura Go's own reminder (same template and wording, amount due, link to the invoice). Two steps: without confirmation_token nothing is sent and the result is a preview (invoice, client, amount due, channel, masked recipient, the exact message) with a confirmation_token valid 10 minutes for one use; call again with the same arguments and the token only after the user answered (a confirmation sent within 10 seconds of the preview is refused). Not for a Shopify order's invoice. Email when the client has one. When the client has only a phone, Fatura Go sends nothing: the confirmed result is a WhatsApp link with the message for the user to open. At most one reminder per invoice per 24 hours from an assistant. Needs the send permission. Do not use it to send a new invoice or a statement: those are sent from Fatura Go.

business_id.description: From list_businesses. May be left out: the invoice is then looked up in every business shared with this connection.

confirmation_token.description: Leave out on the first call (preview). Pass the token from the preview only after the user confirmed it, with the same other arguments.

template_id.description: A payment reminder template of the business, when the user picked one. Default: the template the app would use.
